stations.name: Fluid Transfer and Persistence
manualChecks: Start, allow water transfer, and compare source loss with both tank gains.
Power the fluid switch with redstone; verify complete isolation and recovery.
Test empty, partial, full, matching-filter, and nonmatching-filter metal tanks.
Checkpoint quantities before same-session reload, full restart, and chunk reload.
Break/place the portable tank and confirm fluid stays on its item; metal tank loss is expected.
Run a bounded 30-minute transfer and reconcile every millibucket.

stations.name: Drain and Discharge Reach
manualChecks: Use marked source and flowing water; verify only true source blocks are collected.
Move the nearest source through a stepped field and prove the search remains bounded to 32 steps.
Fill the destination and confirm drain backpressure without deletion.
Discharge into the sealed catch basin and reconcile tank loss with placed source blocks.
Repeat through a Forge fluid-handler block on every accessible face.

stations.name: Oil Distillation House
manualChecks: Distil exactly 2,000 mB crude oil into 1,000 mB refined oil under the default recipe.
Checkpoint input, output, fuel, burn time, and progress at mid-cycle.
Repeat same-session, full-process, and chunk reloads without duplicating fluid.
When Mineralogy is loaded, compare both crude-oil lanes and require the same 2:1 refined-oil yield.
Run NORMAL, TECH_PROGRESSION, and APOCALYPTIC recipe overlays.

stations.name: Conveyor Sorting Hall
manualChecks: Run plain horizontal and upward lanes between inventories and from dropped entities.
Exercise the configurable filter with zero, one, and several distinct filters; test matches and nonmatches.
Checkpoint filter slots and comparator levels through same-session and full restarts.
Feed representative block, food, fuel, ore-dictionary, plant, and smeltable items.
For overflow, test lower available/full, forward available/full, and both blocked.
Block every destination and prove no item duplication or silent deletion.
Run the fast lane only while attended; reconcile all bounded items after 30 minutes.

stations.name: Boiler Calibration House
manualChecks: Calibrate all four boilers into isolated tanks with no consumers attached.
Coal: valid/invalid fuels, water scarcity, burn time, and restart persistence.
Electric: verify the 16 electricity to 0.5 steam per-tick relationship.
Geothermal: compare fire and lava, then full-restart temperature for SA-110-002.
Oil: compare Power and Mineralogy crude oil at the same built-in burn value, then verify explicit fuel configuration still overrides it.
Add sustained rated load, isolate output, interrupt supply, and reconcile steam.

stations.name: Steam Distribution Gallery
manualChecks: Compare short and long networks; current code has no distance pressure loss.
Verify machine-to-machine conduction through the middle consumer.
Read every GUI after at least two eight-tick distribution intervals.
Test scarcity, switch redstone, pipe interruption, and recovery without replacement.
Checkpoint work output as well as animation before both reload types.
Confirm GUI and server NBT agree when one middle machine displays low pressure.

stations.name: Steam Storage and Scarcity
manualChecks: Run below combined demand and observe ordinary demand before backup-priority storage.
Apply redstone to the tank/switch branch and prove the remaining network continues.
Record local buffers under scarcity, restored supply, and full restart.
Reconcile boiler steam, tank steam, and actual machine work.

stations.name: Steam Processing Mill
manualChecks: Furnace: valid and invalid inputs, three lanes, fuel, full outputs, automation faces, and mid-cycle restart.
Crusher: BaseMetals recipe and vanilla fallback, invalid input, full five-slot output, and restart.
Compare comparator levels at empty, one, half, and full for SA-110-003.
Measure no-steam versus rated-steam completion without crossing output lanes.
Reconcile all input and output items after interruption and 30-minute operation.

stations.name: Steam Drill Proving Ground
manualChecks: Exercise all six facings in bounded stone targets with rear inventories.
Confirm drops enter the drill or rear output rather than appearing at the bit.
Checkpoint facing, inventory, steam, target, and progress mid-block.
Run same-session/full restarts and verify helper-bit axis restoration.
Let each drill enter aligned track and retain position, energy, inventory, and facing.
Fill output slots and prove mining pauses without deleting blocks or drops.

stations.name: Steam Pumping Station
manualChecks: Pump the bounded 3x3 pool and measure lift and pipe-section costs.
Checkpoint exact internal and output tank contents before a full restart.
Verify SA-110-001: fluid must remain and resume without replacing pump or pipe.
Test empty/full output, interrupted steam, chunk reload, and fluid conservation.
Reset twice and confirm the station removes only its bounded helper shaft.

stations.name: Steam Elevator Works
manualChecks: Test GUI up/down selection and redstone pulse control.
Verify platform stops two blocks below each marked solid ceiling.
Measure 32 steam per move and the effective shaft range.
Restart and chunk-unload mid-travel; no duplicate or stranded platform may remain.
Reset after every recovery case and inspect the declared station bounds only.

stations.name: Musket Proof Range
manualChecks: Measure load interaction, cartridge use, durability, damage, and 64-block maximum trace.
Test configured block interactions only inside the protected copied range.
Repeat Rapid Reload I, Powderless I, High Explosive I/V, and Recoil I/V separately.
Checkpoint loaded item NBT across same-session and full restarts.
Keep explosive trials isolated and attended; reconcile cartridges and shots.

stations.name: Electric Generating Hall
manualChecks: Photovoltaic: dawn, noon, dusk, rain, thunder, roofed darkness, and controlled block light.
Hydroelectric: flowing-water turbine creation/restoration, 4-per-tick output, and entity damage.
Hydroelectric: confirm the EA-110-003 repair opens its GUI and displays a normal-width active power bar.
Steam conversion: verify 31.25 electricity per steam and 32-steam network-update cap.
Run isolated into bounded arrays before rated load, restart, and endurance tests.

stations.name: Battery and Distribution Room
manualChecks: Verify all four battery item capacities at empty, partial, and full charge.
Checkpoint battery item NBT, tooltip percentage, and mixed eight-slot array state.
Observe backup priority under scarcity and switch redstone isolation/recovery.
Compare touching machine-to-machine conduction with cable between each machine.
Restart the complete chain and reconcile stored energy and actual completed work.

stations.name: Electric Processing Works
manualChecks: For each processor test valid, invalid, blocked output, scarce energy, and redstone inhibition.
Checkpoint inventories, energy, and progress at mid-cycle for both reload types.
Verify input is retained whenever outputs are full.
Exercise automation faces, conveyors, and comparator levels.
Reconcile all bounded inputs and outputs after interruption and endurance.

stations.name: Electric Fluid Plant
manualChecks: Measure electric pump base, lift, and pipe costs against bounded water.
Checkpoint exact pump and tank fluid before full restart; require automatic resume.
Distil and refine exact crude/refined quantities with full-output protection.
Test alternate configured fluid registry names and nonmatching fluids.
Interrupt electricity and fluid paths separately; reconcile all millibuckets.

stations.name: Electrified Glasshouse
manualChecks: Supply exactly one dirt, 2,000 mB water, and measured electricity.
Run seed, crop, sapling, and other recognised plant inputs separately.
Retain closed case EA-110-002: leave a second dirt waiting at soil 1,000, then apply load and verify it is consumed after soil falls below 500.
Extend until one chamber starves and reconcile shared greenhouse power.
Checkpoint controller soil, water, electricity, chamber progress, and items through restart.

stations.name: Electric Drill Proving Ground
manualChecks: Repeat the six-facing Steam drill procedure with bounded targets and rear outputs.
Measure 24 energy per progress and 250 per track move.
Checkpoint metadata, target, energy, progress, inventory, and position mid-block.
Run same-session/full restarts including old-world vertical-facing blocks.
Verify all track moves preserve orientation, inventory, energy, and output.
Block outputs and prove no block or drop disappears.

stations.name: Lighting and Defence Range
manualChecks: LED: high-priority draw, light level, interruption, switch control, chunk reload, and restart.
Turret: owner and team persistence, 16-block acquisition, 32-block ray, and target reacquisition.
Measure idle, charging, and 1,000-per-shot energy; count real hits rather than animation.
Use hostile mobs and consenting test players only inside the sealed range.
The hidden evil turret is isolated here solely as part of turret lifecycle testing.

stations.name: Assembler Diagnostic Cell
manualChecks: Copied worlds only: start with recursion 1 and one simple vanilla recipe.
Capture tick time and logs before inserting the reference recipe.
Raise recursion to 2 then 5 only while the server remains responsive.
Stop immediately on sustained tick stall; record EA-110-001 as the hypothesis.
Do not test reversible metal storage recipes in a valued world.
A pass for one material does not clear the wider recipe graph.

stations.name: Public Fluid Network API
manualChecks: After start, open the storage tank and confirm it contains exactly 4,000 mB of water.
Reset before starting this station again; its full-tank rejection is deliberately stateful.
